title: Find why the feed e2e test fails now and then
goal: The cause of the intermittent 'mixing tank emptied' failure is named with evidence
acceptance: The test is repeated under CPU load until it fails or 30 runs pass, with the mixing tank level and feed state logged at the failure
The cause is recorded in B-008: a test or simulator race, or the feed reporting done too early
privacy: Neutral, invented test data only; no Tailscale names, IPs, agent tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Done 2026-11-25 in #38: reproduced under load (3 to 11 of 30 runs failed), logged 'time allowed used' and the litres left; cause: late switch-off on the 1000x test rig.
